test_cases.name: incident_response_report
test_cases.input: Write a professional incident response report for a ransomware incident that started with a phishing email, affected the finance department, and resulted in 2 days of downtime.
assertions: Includes an executive summary suitable for leadership

test_cases.name: cti_report
test_cases.input: Create a cyber threat intelligence report on a new threat actor using living-off-the-land techniques targeting manufacturing companies.
assertions: Includes actor snapshot or equivalent profile
States confidence levels on key judgments

test_cases.name: executive_summary
test_cases.input: Write an executive summary for the board summarizing this quarter's security posture, including a rise in credential-based attacks and successful patching of critical vulnerabilities.
assertions: Can be understood without deep technical knowledge
Focuses on business risk and impact
